en.hubeali:
One of our companions, from Ibn Jamhour, from his father, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Al Mufazzal Bin Umar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Al-Hijr is the house of Ismail<sup>as</sup>, and therein is the grave of Hajar<sup>as</sup>, and grave of Ismail<sup>as</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 14. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Nu’man from Sayf ibn ‘Amirah from abu Bakr al- Hadramiy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that Isma‘il buried his mother in al-Hijr and built a wall of stones around it so that people may not walk on her grave.”
